resources.string: Nothing has changed yet. History couldn\'t save a copy of your edits (the phone may be out of space). If you go on, they\'re gone for good.
Nothing has changed yet. History is off, so no copy of your edits was kept. If you go on, they\'re gone for good.
Edits discarded · History couldn\'t keep a copy, so only Undo brings them back
That file can\'t be reached any more, so your unsaved edits are here, in a new draft. Save as… to keep them where you want.
Edits from last time, as a copy
They couldn\'t be applied to %1$s, so they\'re here, in a new draft. The file itself is unchanged.
These edits to %1$s were set aside earlier. They\'re here, in a new draft; the set-aside copy stays in Storage.
Only the text you typed could be read: what you deleted, and where each piece went, is lost.

The file changed since, and the copy they were made on is gone, so they can\'t be applied to it. Open them as a copy to read and save them. Until then they\'re kept, untouched; editing this file moves them aside, still listed in Settings → Storage.
that file is open here with unsaved edits; save or close it first
Edits that couldn\'t be applied to their file. They\'re never deleted on their own; open one as a copy to read and save it.
Set-aside edits now use %1$s, more than the %2$s kept without asking. Open any you need as a copy, then export and clear the rest. Nothing is deleted until you do.
